name: M2 Live-Proof (/reconcile + /push, v1.1.7 deploy-proof)
goal: Live-prove the v1.1.7 never-lose-work recovery chain (reconcile preserve -> unassigned /push publish -> reconcile_finalization clear) plus reconcile/push/tombstone lanes against the DEPLOYED dist, scratch-isolated, and record a findings doc.

tasks.name: Author + run the M2 live-proof driver; write findings
tasks.description: One B-Prime driver at an absolute scratchpad path builds an airtight scratch sandbox with TWO scratch repos (A,B) + bare origins under one session SID, allocates one managed worktree per repo via the deployed CLI, then runs 10 lanes mint->consume against the deployed dist/*.js. Repo A: R-1->R-2->T-1->P-2a->P-2b->P-2c (preserved-obligation chain). Repo B: R-3->P-1. D-1/N-1 repo-independent. Each lane asserts an exact grounded outcome. Findings doc records results; R6 is documented. No product code changes; the driver IS the falsifiable proof (no TDD). Guardrails: never run git between a lane's mint and consume (evidence must byte-match); each mint cwd inside the correct repo; mint adjacent to consume (intents expire 5min); count LANES not asserts.

steps.description: Read worker/hooks/tests/test-git-authority-activation.sh in full as the skeleton: scratch HOME/WORKSPACE_MANAGER_DB_PATH, hand-built state DB (sessions professional_mode='on', wave_tasks, audit_log), run_prompt() mint helper, node --input-type=module consume heredoc, git init/init --bare/allocate fixtures.

Write driver sandbox + TWO-repo fixtures: set -euo pipefail; WM=/Users/roberthyatt/Code/ironclaude/worker/mcp-servers/workspace-manager/dist; HOOK=.../worker/hooks/state-activator.sh; HOOK_INTENT=$WM/hook-intent.js; INDEX=$WM/index.js; CLI=$WM/cli.js. TMP_HOME=$(mktemp -d); scratch STATE_DB with ONE sessions row (SID, professional_mode='on'); scratch WORKSPACE_DB. Build repo A (git init -b main + commit + bare origin A + push -u) and repo B identically. Allocate one managed worktree per repo: node $CLI allocate {repository_path:repoA,workspace_guid:GUID1,owner_session_id:SID,integration_target:main} (capture WT_A); same repoB/GUID2 (capture WT_B). Define mint <op> <cwd> (run_prompt shape) and consume <op> <argsJSON> [threadId] (node heredoc: deps=createPublicToolDependencies(initCliDb(),{client:'claude',sessionId:SID,invocationThreadId:(threadId||SID),source:'ppid_file'}); push/commit-and-push->deps.finalizeDirect(op,args), reconcile->deps.reconcileWorktree(args), reconcile-finalization->deps.reconcileFinalization(args); print JSON or 'ERR:'+message). pass_lane/fail_lane tallies + literal-grep helper.

Write the lanes (fixed order; exact grounded asserts). REPO A: R-1 (commit in WT_A -> mint reconcile <WT_A> -> consume reconcile {repoA,GUID1} -> '"state":"reconciled"' AND repoA main==WT_A HEAD AND WT_A exists; R-1 recycle returns GUID1 to active). R-2 (stage change + create untracked in WT_A -> mint commit-and-push <WT_A> -> consume commit-and-push {repoA,GUID1,message:m2} -> ERR 'Managed worktree has uncommitted changes' AND DB lifecycle_status='active' + disposition phase 'integration-pending'; rm untracked; mint reconcile <WT_A> -> consume reconcile {repoA,GUID1} -> '"state":"integrated-local"' AND disposition phase 'push-pending' PRESERVED AND repoA main==candidate). T-1 (node $CLI cleanup {repoA,GUID1,SID} capturing stderr+exit -> nonzero exit AND stderr 'Refusing to tombstone a worktree with a push-pending obligation'). P-2a (mint push <repoA> NO guid -> consume push {repoA,workspace_guid:GUID1} -> ERR 'Direct Git operation requires a matching human intent' -- intent will not bind to the terminal integrated row). P-2b (mint push <repoA> NO guid; repoA only assignment is the integrated row -> zero active -> sentinel lane; consume push {repoA} NO guid -> '"state":"pushed-only"' AND originA refs/heads/main==candidate). P-2c (NO mint; consume reconcile-finalization {repoA,GUID1} -> '"state":"cleaned"' AND disposition NULL AND lifecycle_status='active' AND WT_A exists). REPO B: R-3 (uncommitted change in WT_B -> mint reconcile <WT_B> -> consume reconcile {repoB,GUID2} -> ERR 'Managed worktree has uncommitted changes' AND repoB main unchanged). P-1 (git add+commit in WT_B -> mint push <WT_B> -> consume push {repoB,GUID2} -> '"state":"pushed-only"' AND originB refs/heads/ironclaude/<GUID2>==WT_B HEAD). REPO-INDEPENDENT: D-1 (grep -c hasPushPendingObligation/finalizeReconcile/integrated-local/'Refusing to tombstone'/'Push-only authority does not designate active managed workspace' in $INDEX all >0). N-1 (consume reconcile {repoA,GUID1} with BAD_THREAD then consume push {repoA} with BAD_THREAD -> both ERR 'Direct human authority can be consumed only by the provider-root session'). Print 'M2: <lanes_passed> passed, <lanes_failed> failed' (10 lanes); exit 1 if any failed.
steps.expected: driver authored; all assert literals byte-match the grounded source strings.
M2: 10 passed, 0 failed (exit 0). A lane failure is a real deploy defect -> record it, do NOT edit product to force green.
